A destroyed object's three words the template's destructor 0xa3b850 stores last (dead stores) are left out, as the test cites. Mutants: 42/42 killed over src/sg/cExtension.{h,cpp} (lane OY; the GetTypeInfo adapter returning null survived the first run, so Extension_Slots now calls 0xa3c160 and the adapter for their eax).
